serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone is calling me again? 
Is it Big Daddy?
No… {{wi}}The other phone is ringing… {{wi}}The one I got from the organization.
You: Hello?
???: It’s time for your mission, soldier…
That’s really them!
W-what should I do?
???: The time has come, patriot. Get moving.
It’s the same guy who contacted me last time. I think. He’s using a voice changer. 
You: Who are you? 
???: That’s not important.
You: I was supposed to be contacted by Little Richard.
???: And how do you know I’m not Richard?
You: …
You: We were chatting and-
???: Goddammit! That was a secret mission you dumbass! 
???: Do not talk about these missions with anyone else, even your mother! 
You: S-sorry…
???: Whatever. Just shut up about it or next time you're done for.
So Richard really doesn’t know about all of this…
What is going on with this organization…
Something fishy is going on, should I proceed?
If I refuse to follow this guy’s order, I might lose their trust and my chances to uncover their secrets will be gone…
